preconditions.description: The number of routers n must be between 2 and 200000.
The length of the list p must be n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p[i] < i + 1 for i in range(n - 1))
preconditions.description: Each element in p must be between 1 and i.

postconditions.description: The path must start with 1 and end with n.
The length of the path must be between 2 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(path[i] != path[i + 1] for i in range(len(path) - 1))
postconditions.description: All elements in the path must be distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(path[i] in p[:i] or path[i] == 1 for i in range(1, len(path)))
postconditions.description: Each element in the path (except the first) must either be in the previous elements of p or be 1.
